scripts.build:desktop: bun run build && bun x --bun --package=pake-cli pake ./out --name "Learn Taekwondo"
scripts.build:windows: bun run build && bun x --bun --package=pake-cli pake ./out --name "Learn Taekwondo" --targets x64 --keep-binary
scripts.build:android: bun run build && bun x nitron build
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun x nitron build && bun x --bun --package=pake-cli pake ./out --name "Learn Taekwondo"
scripts.commit:
git pull && bun update && bun getSecurity.ts && bun run build && read -p 'Descriptions
 Commit: ' message && git add . && echo -n "$message - " && node getTime.js | xargs -I {} git commit -m "$message - {}" && git push
